rationale: Preserve parallel sink connections for eligible ordinary OLAP upserts using parsed authorization and the established streaming-write eligibility contract.
scope: Only UpsertRows targeting a non-index OLAP table.
Requires enabled OLAP sinks and the legacy permitted query kinds.
Preserves explicit AllowInconsistentWrites; enables consistent streaming only when no same-table read is found.
Traverses logical children and referenced subplans, including source reads and table lookups; a raw EmptySource input conservatively disables consistent streaming.
Map is emitted only when the OLAP-specific helper proved StreamWrite; all other paths retain UnionAll.
Flags are computed at final stage assignment from existing copied Options.Settings, avoiding new mutable operator state.
limits: Update/insert/delete/index effect kinds and non-upsert Mode, Inplace, IsUpdate, IsConditionalUpdate settings stay on their existing path.
Datashard streaming and explicit inconsistent writes on Datashard are outside Q13 scope.
Opaque custom/parameter input retains the existing consistent sink path; a separate proof can expand this conservatively later.
No source checkout changed, branch created, compilation or native test performed.
validation_required: Build RBO and run existing write tests.
Compare sink StreamWrite/InconsistentWrite flags and Map versus UnionAll task topology for OLAP table-fed upserts.
Verify persisted bags across multi-partition input, defaults, batch settings and duplicate keys.
Verify self-read through Source, TableLookup and nested scalar subplan remains UnionAll unless explicit inconsistent writes authorize the legacy exception.
Verify disabled OLAP sink/query-kind gates, row-store, index effects and non-upsert modes retain their existing path.
Verify explicit inconsistent settings survive copying and yield the matching sink flag.
